entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this piece of junk you sent me. I've been waiting on hold for ten minutes and my patience is gone. This is ridiculous.
I'm very sorry to hear you're frustrated, sir. I can definitely look into a return for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
It's VF-8675309. I bought this jersey a while back, finally went to wear it, and it's completely the wrong size. It's way too tight. I can't even get it on properly. Your sizing charts are a joke.
I understand. I've pulled up your order. Just to clarify, is the issue with the jersey a defect, or is it a preference regarding the fit?

Don't play games with me. I just told you, it's the wrong size! It's too tight! I want to exchange it or get my money back. Are you going to do that or do I need to speak to your manager right now? I'm one click away from leaving a one-star review everywhere.
There's no need for that, sir, I can absolutely help you. I just needed to confirm the reason. Let me check the return eligibility for you... One moment.
Unbelievable. This is the last time I ever buy from VeloFit.

Thank you for waiting. I see here that you received the jersey 79 days ago. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can process an exchange for a different size or a full refund, whichever you prefer.
Oh. It's... it's within 90 days? Seriously?
Yes, absolutely. We can definitely get this sorted out. Would you like to do the exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer the refund?
Okay... well, that's better. Let's just do the exchange then. I guess I'll try one size up.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Just pack up the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. Your new order will ship out as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
